responseMessageContents.text:
I don't have a way to receive credential values through this chat — and I wouldn't accept them here even if sent, since that would mean secrets passing through conversation text, which I avoid by design.

Nothing has changed since my last check: the worker service `ivx-senior-dev-01` still has no `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_API_KEY`, and the owner session is still expired. Both need to be fixed at the source (Render dashboard, Supabase sign-in), not sent to me as text.

When you're ready:
- Confirm in the Render dashboard, on the **`ivx-senior-dev-01`** service specifically, that the key is saved and a new deploy actually ran (check its Events tab for a fresh deploy timestamp).
- Sign in again in the app/Supabase to get a new session, and I can validate it the same way I did before — I check its validity against the live API, I don't need you to paste the raw token into chat for me to do that safely, but if it's already in this environment's variables I'll pick it up automatically on recheck.

Just say "recheck" once you've done the Render save and re-signed-in, and I'll run the same verification pass immediately.
